The '''2016 Bespin Regionals''' was the Saturday regional of the Bespin Super Weekend (16–17 July 2016), organized by [[Mark Walseth]].<ref name="bespinreg2016">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1049285#p1049285 Saturday Bespin Regional standings], Walsetmd, forum.starwarsccg.org (28 July 2016). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122222942/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1049285.html Internet Archive].</ref> Bryan won.<ref name="bespinreg2016" />
